SELECT b.id as plan_id, b.plan_name, c.client_id, ( SELECT client_name FROM client WHERE id = c.client_id ) AS client_name, c.belong_dept_id, ( SELECT `name` FROM bifrost_org WHERE id = c.belong_dept_id ) AS bizDeptName, r.risk_exposure, (select classify_result from asset_classify_client where client_id = c.client_id order by id desc LIMIT 1) as classify_result, c.payment_date, c.belong_sponsor_id as sponsor_id, (select user_name from bifrost_user where id = c.belong_sponsor_id) as sponsorName, c.risk_manager_id, c.risk_manager_name, b.check_way, b.dead_line, b.term, b.last_check_way, b.last_end_date, b.approval_status, b.create_time, b.update_time FROM new_after_lease_check_plan_base b INNER JOIN (SELECT nac.* FROM new_after_lease_check_plan_client nac WHERE (nac.client_id, nac.id) IN ( SELECT nc.client_id, MAX(nc.id) FROM new_after_lease_check_plan_client nc,new_after_lease_check_plan_base pb where nc.plan_id=pb.id and pb.plan_type = 'COMMONLY' and pb.plan_name like concat('%',#{dto.planName},'%') and nc.client_id=#{dto.clientId} and pb.plan_type = #{dto.planType} and pb.check_way = #{dto.checkWay} and pb.dead_line >= #{dto.deadLineFrom} and #{dto.deadLineTo} >= pb.dead_line GROUP BY nc.client_id )) AS c ON b.id = c.plan_id LEFT JOIN new_after_lease_check_report_base r ON r.check_plan_client_id = c.id
b.plan_type = 'COMMONLY' and b.plan_name like concat('%',#{dto.planName},'%') and c.client_id=#{dto.clientId} and b.plan_type = #{dto.planType} and b.check_way = #{dto.checkWay} and b.dead_line >= #{dto.deadLineFrom} and #{dto.deadLineTo} >= b.dead_line group by c.client_id order by c.id DESC,b.update_time desc

SELECT b.id as plan_id, b.plan_name, c.client_id, ( SELECT client_name FROM client WHERE id = c.client_id ) AS client_name, c.belong_dept_id, ( SELECT `name` FROM bifrost_org WHERE id = c.belong_dept_id ) AS bizDeptName, r.risk_exposure, (select classify_result from asset_classify_client where client_id = c.client_id order by id desc LIMIT 1) as classify_result, c.payment_date, c.belong_sponsor_id as sponsor_id, (select user_name from bifrost_user where id = c.belong_sponsor_id) as sponsorName, c.risk_manager_id, c.risk_manager_name, b.check_way, b.dead_line, b.term, b.last_check_way, b.last_end_date, b.approval_status, b.create_time, b.update_time FROM new_after_lease_check_plan_base b INNER JOIN new_after_lease_check_plan_client c ON b.id = c.plan_id LEFT JOIN new_after_lease_check_report_base r ON r.check_plan_client_id = c.id
b.plan_type = 'COMMONLY' and r.risk_exposure > 0 and b.plan_name like concat('%',#{dto.planName},'%') and c.client_id=#{dto.clientId} and b.plan_type = #{dto.planType} and b.check_way = #{dto.checkWay} and b.dead_line >= #{dto.deadLineFrom} and #{dto.deadLineTo} >= b.dead_line group by c.client_id order by b.update_time desc
